# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_STAGE2_TOP_KEEPER_20260721

## Hypothesis

The strategy uses a volatility-adjusted breakout signal with strict body confirmation and proximity filters to capture bearish momentum. The edge appears to come from avoiding losses on J loser days (showing zero or positive PnL) while capturing partial gains on two of three J winner days (missing 5/01 entirely). The high wide_pnl suggests potential profitability but requires validation against OP-16 anchors.

## Mechanism

Enter on bearish SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK when:  
- vol_mult > 1.1 (volume > 1.1× 20-bar average)  
- body_min_cents >= 0.02 (real body ≥ 2 cents)  
- min_stars >= 2 (at least 2 confluence signals)  
- strike_offset = 2 (2 strikes OTM)  
- proximity_dollars <= 1.5 (within $1.5 of level)  
- require_break_above_open = true (must break above open for validation)  
Exit:  
- premium_stop_pct = -0.06 (6% catastrophic stop)  
- tp1_premium_pct = 0.4 (40% TP1 on 2/3 qty)  
- runner_target_pct = 3.0 (300% runner target)  
- profit_lock_threshold_pct = 0.0 (no profit lock arming)  
- profit_lock_stop_offset_pct = 0.08 (8% trailing stop if armed)  
- tp1_qty_fraction = 0.667 (sell 2/3 at TP1)  
- qty = 10 contracts
